title: DOW-UAP-PR34, Unresolved UAP Report, Greece, October 2023
doc_notes: This document is a declassified USCENTCOM mission report (MISREP 9329374) detailing an ISR mission that encountered a UAP, heavily redacted under 1.4(a) and other exemptions.

incidents.summary: A UAP was observed flying just above the ocean surface, performing multiple 90-degree turns at approximately 80 mph before being lost from the sensor feed.
incidents.quote: THE UAP TOOK MULTIPLE 90 DEGREE TURNS AT AN ESTIMATED 80 MPH.
